selection_rationale: Paired per-fold comparison, simplest first; a more complex family must beat the incumbent by more than the std of the per-fold gap. lightgbm vs logistic_regression: -0.0093 +/- 0.0090 per fold [-0.0017, -0.022, -0.0013, -0.003, -0.0184] -> keep logistic_regression. Selected logistic_regression. Features: 16 of 19 raw after selection.
notes: Feature selection: work/feature_selection.py -> outputs/model/feature_selection.json (rule 'mean', redundancy removed []). Winner's validation-fold predictions: outputs/model/cv_predictions.parquet (for choosing a threshold without test). Winner CV: pr_auc 0.6754, log_loss 0.4159. Test split not used.
